title: Compute tier automatically from standing order volume
body: Tiers are currently set by hand in `accounts.json`. The portal should work out the tier from `standing_order_lb` and `config/tiers.json`, so a change like Corner Table Cafe's gets the right price automatically.

title: Move Corner Table Cafe to tier 2 pricing (20 lb standing order)
body:
Elena Ortiz at Corner Table Cafe is increasing her standing order from 10 lb to **20 lb** of house espresso every two weeks, starting in November. That moves the account from tier 1 ($11.50/lb) to **tier 2 ($10.50/lb)**.

- [ ] Wait for the owner's OK (Linear RIV-8)
- [ ] Update `config/accounts.json`: `standing_order_lb: 20`, `tier: 2`
- [ ] Dana Whitfield emails Elena the confirmation
- [ ] Add Holiday Blend for December if the allocation is approved
